#### Styling
- **Tailwind CSS 3.4.7**: Utility-first CSS framework for rapid UI development
- **PostCSS 8.4.38**: CSS processing tool for Tailwind
- **Autoprefixer 10.4.19**: Automatically adds vendor prefixes to CSS

#### API Integration & Code Generation
- **openapi-typescript 7.4.2**: Generates TypeScript types from OpenAPI 3.0 specifications
- **MSW (Mock Service Worker) 2.4.6**: API mocking library for development and testing

#### Testing
- **Vitest 2.0.5**: Fast unit test framework compatible with Vite ecosystem
- **@testing-library/react 16.0.0**: Testing utilities for React components
- **@testing-library/jest-dom 6.5.0**: Custom matchers for DOM assertions
- **Playwright 1.48.2**: End-to-end testing framework for cross-browser testing

#### Development Tools
- **ESLint 9.8.0**: JavaScript/TypeScript linter with Next.js config
- **ts-node 10.9.2**: TypeScript execution engine for Node.js (used in code generation scripts)
- **js-yaml 4.1.0**: YAML parser for UI specification files
